source_type: documentation + audited Flutter Android M1/M2 implementation preview
premium_services: PVE 9.2 primary; PVE 8.4 regression; optional PBS 4.2/PDM 1.1
android_runner: Generated and hardened by scripts/bootstrap_android.sh; generated runner is not committed
m1_features: secure API-token onboarding, validated profile editing and last-observed server-version metadata
local theme, foreground auto-refresh and node-metric display preferences (F11; source-level only)
on-demand read-only task status and bounded log details (F09; source-level only)
m1_validation: Automated branch CI has passed source checks, analyzer, tests and Android debug APK build for the M1 safety implementation; live PVE/device release validation remains open.
android_build_evidence: Historical CI debug builds verified; consult the latest Actions checks for the current commit. No local APK build was run during the cross-check audit.
m1_safety_followup: Implemented: per-guest single-flight, profile/snapshot revalidation, bounded task verification, ambiguous-outcome lockout, auth-revocation fail-closed handling and race regression tests.

features: read-only per-node storage overview
recent server task history using active+archive task-list normalization
partial permission/failure/malformed-record reporting
guest/node uptime and explicit freshness display
profile-scoped guest favorites persisted in local app preferences
guest list filters for favorites, running and stopped workloads
local QEMU/LXC and node guest filters, combined search, and deterministic favorites/name/VMID/CPU/memory sorting
up to 12 profile-scoped named saved guest views for local search/filter/sort criteria
on-demand read-only guest CPU/memory RRD performance history for 1h/24h/7d windows
read-only guest tag/pool discovery, search, exact filtering and saved-view criteria from cluster inventory
on-demand read-only node CPU/memory RRD performance history for 1h/24h/7d windows
on-demand read-only per-storage used/total RRD capacity history for 1h/24h/7d windows
foreground-only in-app incident inbox for explicit node-state problems, failed recent server tasks and failed/unknown session tasks
profile-scoped foreground CPU/storage threshold rules for exact visible node, guest and per-node storage targets, evaluated only from live foreground refreshes
foreground threshold duration confirmation and hysteresis: rules can require consecutive usable live samples before firing and a lower clear threshold before resolving
shared Material 3 status components, home incident summary, pull-to-refresh detail routes and a scoped MaterialApp rebuild boundary (source-level UI foundation)
tabbed guest/node/storage detail routes with explicit read-only history tabs and a persistent guest action bar
compact guest filter sheet with removable active-filter chips and saved-view compatibility
task summary counts, compact tappable server-task rows and lazy task slivers
full-screen foreground threshold-rule add/edit editor with searchable grouped targets
m2_read_cockpit.scope_note: This is a partial M2 read-cockpit slice, not the full premium M2 roadmap.
m2_read_cockpit.release_validation: Real PVE 8.4/9.2 contracts/ACLs and Android device/release gates remain required.

saved_views.storage: SharedPreferences metadata keyed by profile ID; may contain user-entered search text, node names, tags and pool names; never credentials/task logs/metric samples; Android app backup is disabled
saved_views.limits: 12 views per profile, 40-character names, same-name update
saved_views.verification: Automated model/repository/controller/widget coverage and merged exact-head CI evidence exist; device/accessibility/performance gates remain open.

apk_delivery.storage: GitHub Release assets uploaded directly from the signed build runner, following NovelBridge
apk_delivery.publication_trigger: automatic workflow_run after successful Docs and Android checks for a push to main; manual workflow_dispatch on main remains available
apk_delivery.download_links: release page plus ARM64, ARMv7 and checksums URLs in the workflow summary
apk_delivery.existing_artifacts: not deleted; expire or are removed manually
apk_delivery.cache_policy: separate Actions build caches are unchanged
apk_delivery.release_source_sha: workflow_run head_sha for automatic publication; github.sha for manual main dispatch

tls_policy.exception: user-confirmed, saved per-profile insecure opt-in for any HTTPS host; exact host/port scoped with persistent warnings
tls_policy.risk: server impersonation, token theft and command tampering even on LAN; not recommended for production
tls_policy.release_validation: physical Android TLS/security review remains open; see docs/40-profile-tls-option.md

unresolved_release_gates: production signing and dependency/security release review
full premium M2 features explicitly deferred in docs/39-implementation-audit.md
followup_findings: post-UPID inventory refresh must begin after terminal task status (fixed and regression-tested)
invalid map keys in supplemental lists must not discard valid neighboring records (fixed and regression-tested)
controller disposal during secure profile persistence must roll back the newly-created local connection (fixed in full cross-check)
profile deletion must clear malformed saved-view/favorite metadata roots (fixed in full cross-check)
an add-connection route must not be dismissed while its connection check is pending (fixed in full cross-check)

malformed profile metadata must not block valid neighboring profiles or future onboarding; unsafe stored origins remain removable while the gateway rejects them before credentialed I/O (fixed in full cross-check)
task-status authentication loss must become unknown and stop repeated verification polling while preserving the uncertain write lock (fixed in full cross-check)
feature branches run pull-request CI without duplicate push CI; main pushes remain checked before release publication, with PR-number/ref concurrency cancelling stale runs
F09 recent-task list parser now prefers explicit exitstatus over state=stopped; absent terminal exit code remains unknown (synthetic regression only; live PVE fixtures still needed)
F12 retry source formatter drift was corrected using pinned CI formatter output; merged exact-head and main-push CI passed.
Guest RRD history is limited to explicit GET-only AVERAGE hour/day/week CPU/memory trends with route-session isolation; live PVE 8.4/9.2 fixtures and physical Android validation remain pending.

HOME-007 tag/pool browsing is presentation-only over existing cluster inventory; malformed optional metadata does not invalidate guest identity or affect mutation authorization, and live PVE 8.4/9.2 field/ACL fixtures remain pending.
Node RRD history is explicit GET-only AVERAGE hour/day/week CPU/memory history on a profile/generation-scoped route; live PVE 8.4/9.2 fixtures and physical Android validation remain pending.

On-demand task inspection now short-circuits on explicit Android default-network loss, and observed task/guest/node read 401s immediately invalidate live write safety until a clean authenticated refresh (fixed and regression-tested in the 2026-11-06 cross-check).

Storage RRD capacity history is explicit GET-only AVERAGE hour/day/week used/total history on a profile/generation/exact-storage-scoped route; live PVE 8.4/9.2 storage backend/ACL fixtures and physical Android validation remain pending.

ALERT-001 foreground incident inbox derives only from existing authenticated inventory/task data, retains failed-task incidents across incomplete task-history reads, treats unknown node/session task states conservatively, and adds no Android notification/background/relay capability.

ALERT-002/003 foreground threshold rules persist only non-secret profile-scoped selectors/configuration, evaluate exact node/guest CPU and per-node storage usage from live foreground snapshots, retain prior firings across missing/stale samples, and add no background worker or Android notification delivery.

ALERT-006 adds backward-compatible consecutive-sample duration and clear hysteresis to foreground threshold rules; missing samples reset pending confirmation but never resolve an active firing, and no background polling/notification delivery is added.
implementation_audit.current_ci_policy: The current commit must pass Docs and Android checks; test counts alone are not a release claim.
p0_gaps: Full persistent offline guest/node detail cache is not implemented; only optional last-known aggregate counts are cached
Android default-network observation remains unverified on physical Android devices, especially isolated LAN and VPN transitions
unverified_repository_controls: GitHub currently reports main.protected=false; no verified enforced branch protection
repository rulesets are not configured; branch protection remains an administrative follow-up

f01_profile_editing.behavior: edit alias, HTTPS endpoint, TLS verification policy and API token while preserving the profile ID and profile-scoped local metadata
f01_profile_editing.validation: candidate version plus inventory requests must succeed before persistence
f01_profile_editing.credential_policy: leave both token fields blank to retain the encrypted credential; provide both to replace it; partial replacements are rejected
f01_profile_editing.persistence: serialized metadata/secure-vault replacement with best-effort rollback on failure
f01_profile_editing.release_validation: live PVE/device release gates remain open

f02_server_version.behavior: retain and present the last successfully observed PVE version per connection; refresh it on activation
f02_server_version.storage: non-secret profile metadata only; encrypted credentials are not rewritten for version refreshes
f02_server_version.validation: missing, blank or malformed live version responses fail the version check
f02_server_version.compatibility_boundary: informational last-observed value only; no release compatibility claim or automatic feature gating
f02_server_version.release_validation: live PVE 9.2/8.4 compatibility and device/release gates remain open

f12_read_retries.behavior: at most three attempts for transient idempotent GET failures with bounded jittered backoff; never retry POST, TLS, redirects or auth/permission rejections
f12_read_retries.lifecycle: closed profile gateways do not issue delayed retries
f12_read_retries.limits: No persistent guest/detail cache; Android network presence remains separate from PVE endpoint reachability, and full device/network fault-injection validation is still open.
f12_read_retries.release_validation: live PVE 9.2/8.4 and Android device/network fault-injection gates remain open

f11_local_preferences.theme: system (default), light and dark; persisted locally before shell display
f11_local_preferences.refresh: manual (default), 30/60/120-second foreground-only coalesced GET refresh; pauses on inventory/auth failure; never performs background reads or write retries
f11_local_preferences.display: optional node CPU/memory/uptime subtitle on Home; node identity and state retained
f11_local_preferences.storage: nonsecret app-wide SharedPreferences; safe fallback for malformed values; no encrypted credential-vault writes
f11_local_preferences.verification: Unit/controller/widget and foreground timer regressions have passed merged exact-head/main CI; physical Android/network validation remains required.

f09_task_details.behavior: Tap either session tasks or recent server-history tasks for a fresh GET task status and first 100 log lines; no task-log persistence, exports, telemetry or mutations.
f09_task_details.safety: Current profile ID plus connection generation and exact visible UPID/node membership are rechecked before and after reads; explicit Android default-network loss blocks a new read; observed 401 marks live inventory unsafe until clean authenticated refresh; prior-session results are discarded and the route redacts on profile changes.
f09_task_details.parsing: Malformed neighboring log rows are ignored; each line is capped at 500 characters; 403/status/log errors render separately and no authorization failures are retried.
f09_task_details.limitations: PVE 9.2/8.4 endpoint/ACL fixtures, comprehensive F17 log browser/filtering, and physical Android accessibility/security validation remain open.

f12_transport_errors.behavior: Dio and SocketException transport errors are classified as DNS failure, unreachable network route, connect timeout, response timeout or connection loss; UI receives safe, distinct messages.
f12_transport_errors.privacy: Raw socket/OS error text, hostnames and addresses are never displayed or stored by the classifier.
f12_transport_errors.safety: No changes to GET attempt caps, TLS/redirect/auth rules or POST unknown-outcome/single-shot semantics. Unreachable route is not proof the device is offline.
f12_transport_errors.limitations: Android default-network observation is implemented separately, but network presence is not endpoint reachability. Full persistent guest/detail cache and physical device/network fault-injection validation remain open.

f12_offline_overview.scope: Opt-in profile-scoped local summary of last-known node and guest counts, with timestamp and seven-day read eligibility; no node names, guest identities, tokens, endpoints, logs or request bodies in the snapshot.
f12_offline_overview.behavior: Show clearly labeled cached counts after a typed transport failure when a live inventory cannot be loaded. Cached data never creates an Inventory or enables mutations.
f12_offline_overview.security: Cache clears on opt-out, profile deletion, profile edits, and observed authentication 401. Invalid, expired, future-dated or corrupt records are ignored.
f12_offline_overview.limitations: Android default-network observation is now implemented at source level (docs/54). No persisted guest list, per-node detail or storage/task data; live device and PVE verification remain open.

f12_android_connectivity.behavior: Android default-network callback reports available/unavailable/unknown. Loss pauses timed GET/task polling, blocks new on-demand task/guest/node/storage metric reads and mutations, and keeps counts display-only. Recovery requires a clean authenticated read or full cold activation.
f12_android_connectivity.safety: Network available does not establish PVE reachability. Unknown following loss does not unlock actions; no background recovery, mutation replay, or persistent network identifiers.
f12_android_connectivity.tls_presentation: Persistent shell/guest insecure-cert banners removed; header, connection chooser, settings, opt-in and guest action confirmations retain contextual risk information. Strict default and scoped exception unchanged.
f12_android_connectivity.limitations: Real PVE 9.2/8.4 fixtures and physical airplane mode, LAN-only, VPN, lifecycle, race and accessibility testing remain required.

f09_task_pages.behavior: Task detail inspection offers explicit status/log refresh and one read-only log page at a time, from offsets 0/100/200/300/400, with at most 100 lines per request and 500 viewable lines. No automatic polling, task mutation or persistent log cache.
f09_task_pages.safety: Only known UPID/node in the active profile and connection generation can be inspected; status and log errors stay separate; page navigation and refresh revalidate current session and do not replay POSTs.
f09_task_pages.verification: Synthetic controller, Dio and widget regressions plus merged exact-head/main CI have passed; live PVE 8.4/9.2 fixtures and physical Android verification remain open.

f09_task_history_filters.behavior: Local-only case-insensitive search across operation/node/resource/UPID, plus exact node and conservative task status filters (running/succeeded/failed/unknown) for the bounded already-loaded recent server-task list; session UPIDs stay visible and unchanged.
f09_task_history_filters.isolation: Filters and search text remain in transient widget state and are reset on profile switch/reconnect by profile and connection generation; no new network reads, API privileges, persistence or mutation behavior.
f09_task_history_filters.verification: Synthetic filter/widget regressions and source checks have passed merged exact-head/main CI; live PVE 8.4/9.2 fixtures and physical Android review remain open.

guest_io_counters.behavior: Decode optional non-negative cumulative netin/netout/diskread/diskwrite byte counters from existing /cluster/resources inventory for QEMU/LXC guest detail. Display formatted receive/send/read/write totals; unknown fields render unavailable and are never interpreted as live rates.
guest_io_counters.security: Read-only current inventory display with no extra API requests or persistence. Guest page and open power confirmation now redact on profile switch and reconnect, and reject stale confirmations.
guest_io_counters.verification: Synthetic parser and guest-page widget tests have passed merged exact-head/main CI. Live PVE 9.2/8.4 units/availability and physical Android validation remain open.

guest_session_isolation_audit.finding: Guest-detail page previously displayed the old profile's guest identity after a connection switch and accepted the same profile after reconnect; open power confirmation contained the prior target details.
guest_session_isolation_audit.remediation: Capture profile ID and connection generation on navigation, redact the entire guest route and in-flight power dialog on mismatch, and reject obsolete confirmations before requesting a mutation.
guest_session_isolation_audit.tests: Profile-switch and same-profile reconnect widget regressions in app/test/widget_test.dart have passed merged exact-head/main CI.

guest_rrd_history.behavior: Guest detail explicitly loads 1h/24h/7d Proxmox RRD AVERAGE CPU and memory history; timeframe selection alone performs no request and no background polling or persistence is added.
guest_rrd_history.safety: GET-only exact node/type/VMID lookup with active profile ID and connection-generation checks before and after I/O; explicit Android default-network loss blocks new reads; observed 401 marks live inventory unsafe until clean authenticated refresh; profile switches/reconnects discard and redact prior history.
guest_rrd_history.parsing: At most 1,500 response rows are considered; timestamped finite CPU 0..1 and valid mem/maxmem ratios are retained, malformed rows counted, and visual charts include latest/range/sample text alternatives.
guest_rrd_history.limitations: PVE 9.2/8.4 QEMU/LXC RRD fixtures, ACL/resolution/missing-series behavior and physical Android accessibility/performance/security review remain open.

tag_pool_browsing.behavior: Parse optional guest tags and pool metadata from existing /cluster/resources inventory; include them in guest search, exact tag/pool filters, saved named views, list rows and guest details.
tag_pool_browsing.safety: No additional API request or write path. Optional malformed metadata is ignored and does not mark a guest malformed, authorize an action, change target identity or modify fresh-inventory/preflight requirements.
tag_pool_browsing.persistence: Only explicitly saved profile-scoped views may persist selected tag/pool names in existing SharedPreferences metadata. Legacy views without these fields remain compatible.
tag_pool_browsing.limitations: PVE 9.2/8.4 QEMU/LXC tag/pool field availability, ACL behavior, case-sensitive tag settings, nested pool naming and physical Android accessibility/performance remain open.

node_rrd_history.behavior: Home node rows open a profile/generation-scoped detail route with current utilization and explicit 1h/24h/7d Proxmox RRD AVERAGE CPU/memory history. Timeframe selection alone performs no request and history is not persisted.
node_rrd_history.safety: GET-only exact visible node lookup with active profile ID and connection-generation checks before and after I/O; explicit Android default-network loss blocks new reads; observed 401 marks live inventory unsafe until clean authenticated refresh; profile switches/reconnects or node disappearance discard results and redact the route.
node_rrd_history.parsing: At most 1,500 response rows are considered; timestamped finite CPU 0..1 and valid mem/maxmem ratios are retained, malformed rows counted, and charts include latest/range/sample text alternatives.
node_rrd_history.limitations: PVE 9.2/8.4 node RRD fixtures, ACL/resolution/cluster-forwarding behavior and physical Android accessibility/performance/security review remain open.

on_demand_read_fail_closed.behavior: Task-detail plus guest/node/storage RRD reads refuse new I/O when Android reports the default network unavailable. Any observed 401 records authentication loss, hides/purges offline counts and makes current inventory write-unsafe until clean authenticated refresh.
on_demand_read_fail_closed.mutation_boundary: No POST retry, mutation replay, background read, new permission, persistence or endpoint is added.
on_demand_read_fail_closed.verification: Controller regressions cover offline short-circuiting and on-demand 401 invalidation; repository CI is required for every change, while live PVE/physical-device validation remains open.

storage_rrd_history.behavior: Home storage rows open a profile/generation/exact-storage-scoped detail route with current capacity and explicit 1h/24h/7d Proxmox RRD AVERAGE used/total history. Timeframe selection alone performs no request and history is not persisted.
storage_rrd_history.safety: GET-only exact visible node/storage lookup with active profile ID and connection-generation checks before and after I/O; explicit Android default-network loss blocks new reads; observed 401 marks live inventory unsafe until clean authenticated refresh; profile switches/reconnects or storage disappearance discard results and redact the route.
storage_rrd_history.parsing: At most 1,500 response rows are considered; timestamped non-negative used bytes and positive total bytes are retained, percentages require used <= total, malformed rows are counted, and charts include latest/range/sample text alternatives.
storage_rrd_history.limitations: PVE 9.2/8.4 storage RRD fixtures across backend types, ACL/resolution/cluster-forwarding behavior and physical Android accessibility/performance/security review remain open.

incident_inbox.behavior: A fifth Incidents tab shows a badge and locally filters critical/warning signals derived from explicit node offline/unknown states, failed recent server tasks, and failed/unknown session tasks. Node/task incidents drill into existing session-scoped detail routes.
incident_inbox.conservative_refresh: Inventory failures retain the previous node snapshot. Partial task-history reads retain up to 60 previously observed failed-task incidents until a later complete task read; full task-history failures leave prior task data unchanged. Unknown is never presented as healthy.
incident_inbox.privacy: Foreground in-app only. No notification permission/channel, lock-screen payload, WorkManager job, relay registration, persistent incident history, task-log copy or additional PVE endpoint.
incident_inbox.deferred: ALERT-004 through ALERT-014 remain future work where not already covered by foreground inbox behavior; duration/hysteresis, acknowledgement/history, quiet hours/cooldown, Android scheduled checks/notifications, lock-screen privacy controls, certificate/backup reminders and relay/webhooks are not implemented.
incident_inbox.limitations: Live PVE 9.2/8.4 node/task fixtures, ACL/partial multi-node behavior, 200-guest/task performance and physical Android accessibility/lifecycle/network testing remain open.

foreground_threshold_alert_rules.behavior: Up to 32 profile-scoped enabled/disabled percentage rules for exact node CPU, guest CPU and per-node storage usage targets; firing rules appear in the existing incident inbox and drill into matching session-scoped details.
foreground_threshold_alert_rules.conservative_refresh: A usable below-threshold sample resolves an in-memory firing. Missing node/guest samples and incomplete/failed storage refreshes do not falsely resolve prior firings.
foreground_threshold_alert_rules.persistence: SharedPreferences non-secret metadata only; credentials remain in secure storage and incident history is not persisted.
foreground_threshold_alert_rules.deferred: ALERT-006/007/008 duration, hysteresis, quiet hours, cooldown, acknowledgement/history plus Android scheduled checks/notifications and relay/webhook work remain deferred.
foreground_threshold_alert_rules.limitations: Live PVE 9.2/8.4 field/ACL fixtures, physical Android lifecycle/accessibility/network behavior and performance validation remain pending.

alert_rule_duration_hysteresis.behavior: Profile-scoped foreground threshold rules may require 1-10 consecutive usable live samples before firing and 0-20 percentage points of clear hysteresis. The UI exposes 1-10 samples and 0-20 percentage points.
alert_rule_duration_hysteresis.conservative_semantics: Missing/unusable samples reset pending confirmation, but an active firing remains unresolved until a usable sample reaches the lower clear threshold. Reconnect/profile changes clear runtime pending/firing state.
alert_rule_duration_hysteresis.compatibility: Existing saved rules without the new fields decode as one sample and zero hysteresis.
alert_rule_duration_hysteresis.limitations: No wall-clock duration SLA, quiet hours, cooldown, acknowledgement/history, WorkManager, Android notifications or relay/webhook delivery. Live PVE 8.4/9.2 and physical Android validation remain open.

ui_overhaul_foundation.scope: Shared Material 3 theme tokens and components, semantic status badges with icons/TalkBack labels, empty-state recovery actions, pull-to-refresh on guest/node/storage details, home foreground-incident summary, monospace task-log presentation and an app-info version match guard.
ui_overhaul_foundation.rebuild_boundary: MaterialApp no longer rebuilds on every controller notification; theme changes use a dedicated notifier and inventory/task/incident updates rebuild only the active shell subtree.
ui_overhaul_foundation.safety: Presentation-only. No API endpoint, credential, persistence, TLS, POST retry, freshness guard or mutation behavior changes; task logs remain bounded, on-demand and non-persistent.
ui_overhaul_foundation.verification: flutter analyze --fatal-infos and the existing Flutter widget suite pass locally under the available SDK; new component tests cover status semantics and empty-state actions. Live PVE, physical Android TalkBack/contrast/200%-text and golden screenshots remain open.
ui_overhaul_foundation.limitations: Dedicated connection management, AMOLED/high-contrast themes, app lock/biometrics, notification surfaces, golden screenshots and physical-device validation remain future work.

screen_polish.scope: Home metric-card hierarchy, incident severity summary and recovery actions, guest/task clear-filter actions, empty-state refresh actions, task-detail refresh action, connection autofill/keyboard hints, an About/licenses surface and sparkline grid/area styling.
screen_polish.safety: Presentation and local widget-state only. No endpoint, credential, persistence, TLS, POST retry, freshness guard or mutation behavior changes. Refresh actions reuse the existing foreground refresh path.
screen_polish.verification: flutter analyze --fatal-infos, 160 Flutter tests and formatting/source/documentation checks pass locally. Physical Android TalkBack/touch-target/contrast/200%-text and performance validation remain open.
screen_polish.limitations: Dedicated connection management, AMOLED/high-contrast themes, app lock/biometrics, notification surfaces, golden screenshots and physical-device validation remain future work.

guest_detail_tabs.scope: Guest detail now separates identity/live utilization, performance history and I/O counters into three tabs, with a persistent bottom primary action and overflow menu for the remaining power actions.
guest_detail_tabs.safety: The existing execute path, typed-risk confirmation, profile/generation checks, fresh-inventory requirements, single-flight reservation and unknown-outcome lockout are unchanged. No API, credential, persistence, retry or background behavior is added.
guest_detail_tabs.verification: flutter analyze --fatal-infos, 161 Flutter tests, formatting and source/documentation checks pass locally. The new regression covers all three tabs at 320dp/200% text scale without layout overflow. Physical Android TalkBack/touch-target/performance validation remains open.
guest_detail_tabs.limitations: Dedicated connection management, AMOLED/high-contrast themes, app lock/biometrics, notification surfaces, golden screenshots and physical-device validation remain future work.

node_storage_detail_tabs.scope: Node detail separates current utilization from RRD metrics, and storage detail separates capacity/content overview from capacity history, using the same tabbed read-only detail pattern as guest detail.
node_storage_detail_tabs.safety: Read-only. RRD history remains explicit, GET-only, bounded, transient and profile/generation scoped. Timeframe selection alone performs no request. Missing-resource and session-change redaction is preserved.
node_storage_detail_tabs.verification: flutter analyze --fatal-infos, 161 Flutter tests, formatting and source/documentation checks pass locally. Node/storage history regressions select the metrics/capacity tabs explicitly and still verify request timing, summaries, sample counts and profile-switch redaction.
node_storage_detail_tabs.limitations: Physical Android TalkBack/touch-target/contrast/200%-text, 360/393/412dp screenshots and performance benchmarks remain open. Dedicated connection management, AMOLED/high-contrast themes, lock/biometrics, notifications and goldens remain future work.

guest_filter_sheet.scope: Guests now use search plus a filter-count button, a compact quick-status row, removable active-filter chips and a bottom sheet for type/node/tag/pool/sort. Saved views retain the same criteria.
guest_filter_sheet.safety: Presentation and local widget state only. No API, credential, persistence or mutation behavior is added. Filter changes cannot authorize guest writes and still reset on profile switch.
guest_filter_sheet.verification: flutter analyze --fatal-infos, 161 Flutter tests, formatting and source/documentation checks pass locally. Guest browse/filter/sort and saved-view regressions exercise the sheet and active chips; the 320dp/200%-text shell regression still passes.
guest_filter_sheet.limitations: Physical Android TalkBack, sheet-at-scale, touch-target and 200-guest performance validation remain open. Dedicated connection management, AMOLED/high-contrast themes, lock/biometrics, notifications and goldens remain future work.

task_summary_compact_rows.scope: Tasks now shows a running/succeeded/failed/unknown summary card, compact fully tappable server-task rows and lazy sliver lists for session and recent tasks. The per-card View details button was removed in favour of the whole-row target.
task_summary_compact_rows.safety: Read-only presentation only. Task details remain on-demand, bounded GETs with profile/generation checks and no log persistence. No task mutation, polling, API or transport behavior changes.
task_summary_compact_rows.verification: flutter analyze --fatal-infos, 161 Flutter tests, formatting and source/documentation checks pass locally. Task history/filter and task-detail regressions use the whole-row target; the 320dp/200%-text shell regression still passes.
task_summary_compact_rows.limitations: Physical Android TalkBack, touch-target, 200-task performance and 360/393/412dp validation remain open. Dedicated connection management, AMOLED/high-contrast themes, lock/biometrics, notifications and goldens remain future work.

threshold_rule_editor.scope: Threshold rules now use a full-screen add/edit editor with a searchable grouped Nodes/Guests/Storage target picker, threshold and hysteresis sliders, 1-10 consecutive samples, severity choice and a plain-language summary. Rule cards open the same editor prefilled.
threshold_rule_editor.safety: Rules remain profile-scoped non-secret local metadata with foreground-only evaluation. Returned editor results are discarded if the profile or connection generation changed. No background worker, notification delivery, API, credential or persistence behavior is added.
threshold_rule_editor.verification: flutter analyze --fatal-infos, 162 Flutter tests, formatting and source/documentation checks pass locally. Added an edit regression that changes severity through the searchable grouped target picker; the original add-rule regression still passes.
threshold_rule_editor.limitations: Physical Android TalkBack, large-text editor layout, touch-target and 360/393/412dp validation remain open. Connection management, AMOLED/high-contrast themes, lock/biometrics, notifications and goldens remain future work.

ui_cross_check.scope: Pre-merge audit of the UI-overhaul branch compared with main: app bar freshness, guest filter predicate/chips, guest bottom-bar theme fallback, storage capacity layout, alert-rule target-picker insets and large-text actions, alert-rule UI limit documentation, and earlier-slice remaining-work text.
ui_cross_check.checks: git diff/lockfile integrity, docs/source/premium checks, 14 delivery tests, Dart formatting, flutter analyze --fatal-infos, 162 Flutter tests, and generated Android runner hardening. The local debug APK build was attempted but stopped after Gradle stalled on an external artifact download; pinned-toolchain CI remains the compile gate.
ui_cross_check.safety: No PVE endpoint, gateway transport, credential, persistence, TLS, POST-retry or mutation behavior changed. Existing profile/generation and freshness guards remain in place.
ui_cross_check.limitations: Physical Android TalkBack/contrast/200%-text/touch-target/performance and live PVE 9.2/8.4 fixtures remain open. The local SDK is newer than the pinned CI SDK, so exact-head CI is authoritative.

connection_management.scope: Dedicated Connections page with add/edit/test/remove/switch actions, explicit chooser state when saved profiles exist without an active selection, and staged Server → API token → Verify onboarding with read-only PVE version/inventory checks before save.
connection_management.safety: Connection checks use only existing read endpoints and do not persist candidate credentials or switch sessions. Saved-profile tests may refresh last-observed version metadata without rewriting the encrypted token. Existing connect/update methods revalidate before persistence; TLS-insecure attempts still require explicit confirmation.
